rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose noun for facts or arguments that clear someone or support a claim.

example.english: This evidence is a vindication of my claim.
example.traditional: 呢份證據證明我冇講錯。
example.jyutping: ne1 fan6 zing3 geoi3 zing3 ming4 ngo5 mou5 gong2 co3

rows.note: Use this for the inner satisfaction felt after other people admit that you were right.

example.english: When they finally admitted I was right, I felt a real sense of vindication.
example.traditional: 佢哋終於承認我講得啱，我真係有種滿足感。
example.jyutping: keoi5 dei6 zung1 jyu1 sing4 jing6 ngo5 gong2 dak1 ngaam1 ngo5 zan1 hai6 jau5 zung2 mun5 zuk1 gam2

rows.note: Use this when vindication means an official or public clearing of someone’s name, especially after an accusation.

example.english: After years of investigation, he finally received vindication.
example.traditional: 經過多年調查，佢終於得到平反。
example.jyutping: ging1 gwo3 do1 nin4 diu6 caa4 keoi5 zung1 jyu1 dak1 dou3 ping4 faan2
